items.sefariaRef: Talmud Eser HaSefirot, Section VII, List of Answers on Topics 48:1
items.html: (To the question) The aspect of the posteriors that fell from the head of Yeshsut, which fell from the place above the chest to the place below the chest, were corrected in the aspect of the middle line by the illumination of the Rosh from the coupling of the two crowns in Daat, and it enlarged the vessel of Tifferet to its end. (p. 559, Item 32)
